info.title: Gemini and Google Flow Media API
info.summary: Generate media and manage Google Flow projects, uploads, scenes, characters, voices, agent sessions, and tools.
info.description:
Authenticate with an API key as a Bearer token, in the x-goog-api-key header, or in the key query parameter. Create, retrieve, and extend gemini-omni-1.1-flash videos. New videos default to 9:16 portrait, where the official default is 16:9. A new video goes to an account below 80% of its five-hour usage and 90% of its weekly usage with enough video allowance left; when none qualifies, creation fails with 409 account_unavailable until usage resets. A continuation runs in its original conversation while that account can serve; otherwise another account continues from the stored video and returns a new id to continue from.

Explicit 720p is accepted for fresh text/image generation only. Omit resolution for video inputs and previous_interaction_id: those requests inherit their source resolution. The other official resolutions (360p, 1080p, 4k), explicit duration controls, and tasks other than extend are rejected. Extension length is not guaranteed.

Use background=true with store=true to receive an interaction id before completion. URI delivery returns files/{id} on creation or SSE; subsequent GET returns inline video data. Each serving account keeps its 16 newest stored interactions; an older id can no longer be retrieved or continued.

Errors answer {"error": {"code", "message"}}: code is the identifier, such as account_unavailable, and message repeats it, behind a gemini_web_omni: prefix for a failure raised during a turn, continuing after ': ' with the product's reply when a turn was answered without a video. Failures the gateway raises before a request reaches this service answer the gateway's own object with message and type: a non-boolean stream, or every account held back by the gateway itself. A missing or unknown API key answers 401 with error as a string.

Files support resumable uploads up to 100 MiB, with chunks up to 16 MiB and 256 KiB nonfinal granularity. Upload sessions expire after 24 hours. The session URL authorizes only that upload; keep it private. Generated files can be downloaded; uploaded inputs cannot. Uploads, deletion, and URI output require operator-configured writable storage. Unavailable storage returns a named 503 error.

Flow projects and media live under /v1/flow/projects, at the origin root rather than under /v1beta, so those paths override the server. They need the same API key as every other route. All API keys share the one Flow account the operator configured, so every key sees the same projects and media; nothing is split per key. Responses never include cookies or account credentials. A media url is a signed link that fetches the file without credentials: treat it like a secret. DELETE on a media item moves it to the Flow trash (it archives it), and POST :restore brings it back. Errors from these routes answer {"error": {"code", "message"}} with string values.

The /v1/flow API uses the single configured Flow account shared by authenticated CPA API keys. Agent and tool-builder responses are buffered until completion. Generated tool UI source executes in a browser. Google likeness registration requires the account holder to complete the returned verification link. Flow Omni does not currently advertise native video extension; Veo can extend compatible Omni output.

origin.description: Base origin URL for the proxy API

post.summary: Generate an image or video through Google Flow.
post.description:
Returns one to four completed media items (candidateCount) as base64 inlineData. Models: flow-nano-banana-2 (Nano Banana 2.1) and flow-nano-banana-pro for images; flow-veo-3.1-fast, flow-veo-3.1-quality, flow-veo-3.1-lite, and flow-omni-1.1-flash for videos. Options are checked against the live Flow catalog and the account tier before submission; an unavailable combination answers 400 flow_model_options_unsupported. Each Flow request is an independent generation; previous_interaction_id is not supported. Allow the response to finish and never automatically replay an ambiguous submission. A flow_unauthenticated message refers to the linked Google session, not necessarily the caller's API key.

Every part carries flow.mediaId and flow.projectId. A mediaId is the Flow media UUID of that output, not a workflow, operation, Gemini file, or interaction id. Send it back in flow.baseImage, flow.referenceImages, flow.firstFrame, flow.lastFrame, flow.sourceVideo.mediaId, or a structuredPrompt reference, with flow.projectId, to edit, extend, or upscale a result. Ids only work on the Flow account that owns them. Video and audio bytes cannot be uploaded: use existing Flow media ids. Only images can be sent inline. Extension length is not guaranteed (a live 720p extension returned 7 seconds); a video edit lasts as long as the selected clip.

Streaming: POST /models/{model}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse sends the finished response as one JSON chunk per data line. The same models also answer OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, and Claude requests, which accept this generationConfig object at the top level (n and seed map to candidateCount and seed). Chat returns images in message.images[].image_url.url as data URLs and videos as a data URL in message.content. Responses returns image_generation_call items (base64 in result) and videos as output_text data URLs. Claude returns text blocks holding data URLs. Each of these three carries a top-level flow array of {mediaId, projectId, candidateIndex, partIndex}. Their streams deliver finished media: Chat sends chunk events, a finish chunk, then [DONE]; Responses sends response.created through response.completed; Claude sends message_start through message_stop.

parts.text: A yellow paper boat on calm blue water, no text.
A yellow paper boat floating on calm blue water, gentle ripples, static camera.
An orange paper fox on a white table.

200.description: One generated image or MP4 video per candidate, each with its Flow media reference.

400.description: Invalid or unsupported generation options, such as flow_unsupported_generation_option, flow_model_options_unsupported, flow_conflicting_inputs, flow_mode_required, flow_too_many_references, or flow_source_video_unavailable.

401.description: Caller authentication or the linked Google session was rejected.

409.description: The account is busy (flow_session_exchange_busy) or requires operator reconciliation. Do not retry automatically if the first attempt may have been accepted.

429.description: Google Flow credits or quota are exhausted.

502.description: Upstream generation failed. Do not automatically replay flow_submission_outcome_unknown.

503.description: The token provider or shared session service is unavailable.

post.summary: Create a video interaction or extend a prior video.
post.description:
Creates one new turn. Send only the new prompt and media, not the conversation history. The prompt is limited to 8000 characters and the complete request body to 4 MiB; use Files references for larger media.

To extend, provide previous_interaction_id or a video input and generation_config.video_config.task=extend. Keep the same API key and retain the newest returned id. The previous interaction must have completed with a video. A continuation runs in its original conversation while that account can serve; when it cannot, another account continues from the stored video and the returned id continues from there. Extension length is not configurable or guaranteed.

Explicit 720p is supported only for fresh text/image generation. Omit resolution for continuations and video inputs; otherwise the request is rejected with interaction_resolution_inherited.

URI delivery returns a files/{id} reference on creation or SSE and requires writable storage. GET retrieves inline video data. background=true requires store=true and returns an id with in_progress before generation completes. A synchronous turn that is still rendering when its wait ends also returns in_progress with its id. After an uncertain POST, retrieve an assigned id rather than submitting again.

freshPrompt.summary: Fresh video generation from text prompt

value.input: A yellow paper boat floating on calm blue water, static camera.
Continue the same shot smoothly, keeping the paper boat in frame.

extendUploadedVideo.summary: Extend a video after uploading it with the Files API

content.text: Continue the scene from its final frame.

value.input: Origami crane folding itself on wooden desk.
Time-lapse of sunrise over a misty mountain ridge.

200.description: Interaction snapshot. status=completed carries the video in steps[0].content[0] as data, or as uri when delivery=uri. status=in_progress means the video is still rendering; retrieve the id later. An error beside in_progress reports why the latest check could not finish. status=failed carries the error that ended the turn. With stream=true the body is server-sent events.

schema.description: Server-sent events. Each event has event: and id: <interaction_id>:<n> lines, and its JSON data repeats event_type and event_id. A completed turn emits interaction.created (1), step.start (2), step.delta (3, the video content part), step.stop (4), interaction.completed (5, the full interaction), and done (6, data [DONE]). A failed turn, such as one answered without a video, emits interaction.failed (2) with status=failed and error, then an error event whose data holds the same error and the interaction. A turn still rendering when the wait ends emits only an error event with code interaction_pending_retrieve_receipt and the in_progress interaction; retrieve its id. Any other failure ends the stream with an error event whose data is the error object. Comment lines such as : keep-alive may appear. Resume with GET ?stream=true&last_event_id=<interaction_id>:<n>.

400.description: Rejected before generation. unsupported_interaction_request: a field that is unknown (duration included) or of the wrong type, or a body over 4 MiB. interaction_resolution_unsupported: a resolution other than 720p. interaction_resolution_inherited: a resolution with a video input or previous_interaction_id. interaction_task_unsupported: a task other than extend. interaction_extend_requires_source: extend without previous_interaction_id or a video input. interaction_background_requires_store: background=true with store=false. interaction_inline_video_only: response_format.type other than video, or delivery other than inline or uri. interaction_text_input_only: a part type other than text, image, or video. interaction_reference_invalid: a media part with neither uri nor both data and mime_type. interaction_uploaded_reference_unsupported: a uri that is neither files/{id} nor a Google Drive file. omni_prompt_length_invalid: an empty prompt, or one over 8000 characters. omni_invalid_aspect_ratio: an aspect ratio other than 16:9 or 9:16. continuation_identity_mismatch: a previous_interaction_id this API key cannot continue: unknown, created with store=false, evicted, or made with another key.

continuation.summary: A previous_interaction_id this API key cannot continue

403.description: The product denied the serving account's request, for example web_rpc_denied.

404.description: A files/{id} reference that does not exist for this API key (file_not_found), or a serving account that no longer offers video (account_model_unavailable).

409.description: No account can take the turn now. account_unavailable: no account below 80% of its five-hour usage and 90% of its weekly usage has enough video allowance left for a new video, or none is ready; retry after usage resets. continuation_account_unavailable: the account holding previous_interaction_id cannot serve, and no other account can take the continuation or the previous interaction has no finished video to carry. continuation_not_complete: the previous interaction has not completed with a video (a first turn that ended without one can only be retried, not extended). session_busy or session_requires_reconciliation: the serving account could not start the turn; retry later.

422.description: The product answered the turn without a video (no_video_generated). The message continues after ': ' with its reply when it gave one, for example a declined prompt or a spent daily video allowance. Streaming and background turns report this on the interaction instead, as status=failed with error.code=no_video_generated.

502.description: The upstream response could not be read or retrieved.

503.description: Required storage or provider service is unavailable. URI output requires operator-configured writable storage: files_requires_drive_write_oauth without Drive OAuth, files_drive_write_permission_required with read-only Drive access.

get.description: Retrieves an interaction created with the same API key. Retrieval never starts a new generation and stays on the account that holds the interaction. Completed GET responses contain inline base64 video data even when creation requested URI delivery. Set stream=true for events, and last_event_id or the Last-Event-ID header to resume after a cursor.

parameters.name: interaction_id
parameters.description: Unique 64-character hexadecimal interaction ID.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Stream server-sent events for retrieval or completion replay.

parameters.name: last_event_id
parameters.description: Event cursor to resume SSE replay from (formatted as <interaction_id>:<index>).

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Event cursor used when the last_event_id query parameter is absent.

200.description: Interaction snapshot: completed with inline video, in_progress while rendering (an error beside it reports why the latest check could not finish), or failed with error.

schema.description: Replayed or live interaction events when stream=true.

400.description: A malformed event cursor (invalid_interaction_event_id), or a stream value other than true or false.

404.description: No interaction with this id for this API key (interaction_not_found): unknown, malformed, created with store=false, evicted, or made with another key.

409.description: The account holding the interaction is disabled or unavailable (account_disabled, continuation_account_unavailable). Retrieval does not move to another account; retry later.

422.description: The turn ended without a video (no_video_generated), with the product's reply after ': ' when it gave one.

origin.description: Base origin URL for upload endpoints

post.summary: Start a resumable media file upload.
post.description: Starts a resumable upload for a file up to 100 MiB. Declare the total byte size and MIME type in the upload headers. Success returns X-Goog-Upload-URL: send chunks to that exact private URL. The session expires after 24 hours, with nonfinal chunks aligned to the returned 256 KiB granularity. Upload creation requires an API key and operator-configured writable storage; unavailable write authorization returns a named 503 error.

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Protocol
parameters.description: Upload protocol indicator. Must equal resumable.

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Command
parameters.description: Command to run. Must equal start.

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Header-Content-Length
parameters.description: Total length of file in bytes. Maximum limit is 104,857,600 (100 MiB).

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Header-Content-Type
parameters.description: Valid media MIME type of the upload (e.g. video/mp4, image/png).

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-File-Name
parameters.description: Optional fallback display name, bounded at 512 runes.

200.description: Resumable session opened. Location provided in X-Goog-Upload-URL header.

X-Goog-Upload-URL.description: Upload destination URL carrying the 24-hour scoped capability token.

X-Goog-Upload-Chunk-Granularity.description: Chunk step size (256 KiB). Intermediate chunks must align to this granularity.

400.description: Malformed protocol headers, negative size, unsupported MIME type, or metadata mismatch.

409.description: A file with the specified custom ID already exists.

503.description: Storage is unavailable or its write authorization is missing.

origin.description: Base origin URL for upload endpoints

post.summary: Transfer chunks, query progress, or finalize an upload.
post.description:
Send chunks up to 16 MiB to the exact session URL returned at creation. Nonfinal chunks must be multiples of 256 KiB. The upload_id capability authenticates this route without an API-key header and always retains the original owner. Do not share it.

Use upload for intermediate bytes, upload,finalize for the final chunk, finalize to finish, and query with an empty body to check the received offset. The supplied offset must match the received byte count. Finalized sessions may be queried until expiry but do not accept more bytes. Deleted or replaced files invalidate their session.

parameters.name: upload_id
parameters.description: Private opaque upload-session capability, valid for 24 hours.

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Command
parameters.description: Transfer command name.

parameters.name: X-Goog-Upload-Offset
parameters.description: Starting byte offset. Must match the exact received byte count on the server.

schema.description: Chunk bytes up to 16 MiB. Must be empty for query and standalone finalize.

200.description: Chunk accepted, status queried, or file finalized.

X-Goog-Upload-Status.description: Status active while in progress; final when completed.

X-Goog-Upload-Size-Received.description: Total count of bytes successfully received so far.

oneOf.description: Empty object returned while upload status remains active.

400.description: Offset mismatch, unaligned chunk size, or body provided on query/finalize.

401.description: Missing, malformed, or invalid upload-session capability.

409.description: Upload already finalized or upload session unavailable.

410.description: Upload capability token has expired (lifetime is 24 hours).

413.description: Chunk exceeds the 16 MiB single-request limit.

502.description: Storage backend transfer or checksum mismatch error.

503.description: Storage is unavailable or its write authorization is missing.

get.summary: List stored files for the authenticated caller.
get.description: Returns a paginated list of files belonging to the authenticated caller scope. Includes both uploaded reference files and generated videos created with delivery=uri.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of files to return (between 1 and 100, default 10).

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token bound to the caller.

get.summary: Retrieve metadata for a specific file.
get.description: Retrieves metadata for a file owned by the API key. Use the bare file ID in this URL path; SDK methods also accept the returned files/{id} resource name.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: File ID without the files/ prefix.

404.description: File not found, deleted, or owned by another caller.

delete.description: Marks the file for deletion and removes the underlying storage object. Deletion retries are idempotent.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: File ID without the files/ prefix.

404.description: File not found or owned by another caller.

503.description: Storage is unavailable or required write authorization is missing.

get.description:
Streams the binary media bytes of a generated file (created via delivery=uri). The query parameter alt=media is required.

Only files with source=GENERATED and state=ACTIVE can be downloaded. Uploaded input files cannot be downloaded through this endpoint (rejected with HTTP 400 only_generated_files_can_be_downloaded).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: File ID without the files/ prefix.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Media download specifier. Must equal media.

Content-Type.description: MIME type of the media file.

400.description: Missing alt=media parameter, file state is not ACTIVE, or attempted download of an UPLOADED source file.

404.description: File not found or owned by another caller.

502.description: Storage backend media stream unavailable or size mismatch.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Requested page size

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque provider continuation token

bearerAuth.description: Bearer API key header (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY).

apiKeyAuth.name: x-goog-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Alternative to Bearer authentication for Interactions, upload creation, and ordinary Files operations.

apiKeyQuery.name: key
apiKeyQuery.description: API key in the key query parameter, as in the official REST examples. Prefer a header: query strings are more likely to be logged.

uploadIdAuth.name: upload_id
uploadIdAuth.description: Private 24-hour upload-session capability returned in X-Goog-Upload-URL. No API-key header is required on this session route; an API key does not replace the capability.

FlowMediaId.name: media
FlowMediaId.description: Flow media ID, the mediaId returned with generated output.

FlowPageSize.name: pageSize
FlowPageSize.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

FlowPageToken.name: pageToken
FlowPageToken.description: Opaque token from a previous nextPageToken.

FlowInvalidRequest.description: Invalid request. Codes: flow_project_request_invalid, flow_project_title_invalid, flow_page_size_invalid, flow_page_token_invalid, flow_archived_filter_invalid, flow_media_type_invalid.

FlowRouteNotFound.description: flow_route_not_found: the project or media ID is malformed.

FlowConflict.description: The request can't run right now. Codes: flow_single_account_required (the service doesn't have exactly one Flow account configured), flow_media_not_ready (no url yet), flow_media_workflow_unavailable (nothing to archive or restore).

FlowUpstreamInvalid.description: Flow answered with something unexpected, such as flow_project_response_invalid, flow_project_list_invalid, flow_project_identity_mismatch, or flow_media_identity_mismatch.

FlowCropCoordinates.description: Normalized crop edges. top must be below bottom and left below right.

FlowMediaReference.description: An existing Flow media id or an inline image, with an optional crop.

FlowStructuredPromptPart.description: Either text, or a reference with exactly one id.

FlowOptions.description: Flow-specific options under generationConfig.flow. Ids are opaque strings of up to 256 characters without whitespace.

mode.description: auto picks frames when a frame is set, edit when baseImage is set, references when any other reference is set, and text otherwise. sourceVideo never infers a mode: set edit, extend, or upscale. text takes no references. references needs at least one reference image, audio, likeness, or entity. frames (video) needs firstFrame, lastFrame is optional, and nothing else may be set. edit needs baseImage (image) or sourceVideo (video). extend (video) needs sourceVideo. upscale needs baseImage with a mediaId and no crop (image, imageSize 2K or 4K) or sourceVideo without a frame range (video, resolution 720p, 1080p, or 4K); it takes no prompt text, references, priority, or durationSeconds, and candidateCount must be 1. Native extend is currently advertised only for Veo families, not Flow Omni.

priority.description: low is accepted only by flow-veo-3.1-lite. Not valid for images or upscale.

projectId.description: Existing Flow project of the linked account. If omitted, the plugin creates and reuses a CLIProxyAPI project for its lifetime. Supply an explicit projectId to retain the same project across restarts.

modelKey.description: Exact Flow model usage key from the live catalog. It must stay inside the requested model's family.

referenceImages.description: Image models accept at most 10 references in total, counting contents images and baseImage. Video limits come from the live catalog for the model.

sourceVideo.description: Video only. An existing Flow video media id, optionally limited to a frame range.

referenceAudio.description: Video only. Existing Flow audio media ids.

destination.description: Existing Flow output destination. position requires sceneId. Image generation rejects sceneId; image upscale rejects destination. Wire-tested; destination placement has not been verified live.

structuredPrompt.description: Replaces the text prompt. Sending text in both returns flow_prompt_conflict.

contents.description: The last user turn is the prompt. Its text parts are joined, and its inlineData images become references. fileData is rejected. Upscale needs no prompt text: send an empty text part.

generationConfig.description: Unknown keys answer 400 flow_unsupported_generation_option. temperature, topP, topK, maxOutputTokens, responseModalities, thinkingConfig, stopSequences, presencePenalty, frequencyPenalty, and responseMimeType are accepted and ignored.

candidateCount.description: All outputs come from one Flow batch. Must be 1 for upscale.

seed.description: Images (not image upscale) and video upscale only. Rejected for video generation.

aspectRatio.description: Images accept all five and default to 1:1. Video accepts 9:16 (default) or 16:9. Set it to the source ratio for a video upscale.

durationSeconds.description: Video only. 10 seconds is available only for Omni. Rejected for video edit and upscale.

resolution.description: Video only. 360p is Omni only. 1080p and 4K generate at 720p and then upscale; 4K needs an account tier that allows it. Required for upscale, which accepts 720p, 1080p, and 4K.

aspectRatio.description: A value different from generationConfig.aspectRatio answers flow_conflicting_aspect_ratio.

imageSize.description: 2K and 4K generate first and then upscale. Required (2K or 4K) for image upscale.

id.description: Flow project ID. Pass it as flow.projectId when generating.

nextPageToken.description: Present when more projects follow. Send it as pageToken.

title.description: Project title. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; control characters are rejected.

id.description: Flow media ID, the same value as mediaId on generated output.

workflowId.description: Flow workflow that holds the item. Trash and restore act on it.

title.description: Present in the list response only.

mimeType.description: Omitted when unknown, as for audio.

url.description: Signed link that fetches the media without credentials. Omitted until the media is ready. Don't log or share it.

archived.description: True for trashed media. Present in list responses; omitted when workflow state has not been read.

mediaId.description: Opaque Flow media identifier, including possible upscale suffixes. Pass it back unchanged to edit, extend, or upscale it.

projectId.description: Flow project that holds the output. Pass it back as flow.projectId.

model.description: Target model. Only gemini-omni-1.1-flash is served by this endpoint.

input.description: Prompt text, list of direct input parts, or an official SDK user_input wrapper.

oneOf.description: Plain text prompt, bounded at 8000 runes.

previous_interaction_id.description: Id of a completed, stored interaction created with the same API key. Its conversation continues on the account that holds it while that account can serve; otherwise another account continues from its stored video, and the returned id belongs there. Sending another interaction from the same id replaces the turn an earlier one added to that conversation, as the Gemini app's prompt edit does, so a failed or refused turn can be retried with the same id without the failed attempt staying in the conversation. A first turn that ended without a video is retried the same way: name it, or the newest failed attempt at it, without task=extend, and the new turn edits that first message in the same conversation.

store.description: Retain the turn for later retrieval and extension. Each serving account keeps its 16 newest stored interactions. Background requests require store=true.

background.description: Asynchronous execution flag. When true, returns immediately with status=in_progress and the interaction id. Requires store=true.

stream.description: Stream server-sent events for turn progress.

mime_type.description: Media MIME type. Required when data is provided.

data.description: Base64-encoded media bytes without data URL prefix.

uri.description: Supported Drive URI or Files API reference (files/{id}).

UserInputStep.description: Wrapper structure emitted by google-genai 2.24.0 containing turn parts.

task.description: Only extend is accepted, with previous_interaction_id or a video input. The other official tasks (text_to_video, image_to_video, reference_to_video, edit) return interaction_task_unsupported. Duration cannot be configured or requested.

thinking_level.description: Gateway extension, not in the official API: the web app's thinking level for the video turn. Omitted sends standard. Other values return omni_invalid_thinking_level.

language.description: Gateway extension, not in the official API: the interface language the video turn is sent to the web product with. Omitted sends en. Other values return omni_invalid_language.

video_mode.description: Gateway extension, not in the official API: the capability mode the video turn runs on, for example 1 for 3.8 Flash, 3 for 3.1 Pro and 6 for 3.5 Flash-Lite as advertised on the current accounts. Omitted uses the serving account's standard mode (1). A mode the serving account does not advertise returns 400 omni_video_mode_unavailable and nothing is sent; there is no fallback to another model. Values below 1 or non-integers return omni_invalid_video_mode.

ResponseFormat.description: Output formatting controls. Unlisted settings remain unsupported.

delivery.description: inline returns base64 video data. uri requires writable storage and returns files/{id} in creation/SSE output. GET interactions returns inline data in either case.

aspect_ratio.description: Framing orientation. The default 9:16 yields 720x1280 portrait, unlike the official 16:9 default. Set 16:9 for 1280x720 landscape. Other ratios return omni_invalid_aspect_ratio. Retain the ratio when extending.

resolution.description: 720p is supported for fresh text/image generation only. Omit resolution with video inputs or previous_interaction_id; those requests inherit their source resolution and otherwise return interaction_resolution_inherited. The other official values (360p, 1080p, 4k) return interaction_resolution_unsupported.

account.description: Optional readable name of the account that served the turn: the lowercased local part of the account label's email address (or the lowercased label), or a six-hex short id when no label is known. Display only; do not use it to construct requests.

account_usage.description: Optional share of each quota window the serving account had used when it was last read, in percent with one decimal. A window never read has no key; the object is absent when neither was read. Present only beside account.

status.description: in_progress: still rendering; retrieve the id later. completed: the video is in steps. failed: error says why the turn ended.

steps.description: One model_output step holding the video once completed, empty otherwise. user_input and thought steps are not returned.

data.description: Base64-encoded video bytes. Omitted when URI delivery is selected on creation.

uri.description: Resource identifier (files/{id}) delivered when response_format.delivery=uri is set.

InteractionError.description: Why a failed turn ended, or beside in_progress why the latest check could not finish.

message.description: The code, followed by ': ' and the product's reply when it gave one.

name.description: Canonical resource identifier formatted as files/{id}.

sizeBytes.description: Total size in bytes formatted as decimal string.

updateTime.description: RFC3339 last update timestamp in UTC.

downloadUri.description: Relative download endpoint path (/v1beta/files/{id}:download?alt=media). Present only for GENERATED media files.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the stored file.

source.description: Source origin of file: UPLOADED by caller or GENERATED by video interactions.

name.description: Optional custom resource name formatted as files/{id}.

nextPageToken.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

GeneralError.description: Error body. code is the identifier; message repeats it, possibly behind a gemini_web_omni: prefix and followed by the product's reply. Failures the gateway raises before a request reaches this service answer message and type instead, and a missing or unknown API key answers error as a string.

code.description: The error identifier, such as account_unavailable.

message.description: The identifier, possibly behind gemini_web_omni: and followed by ': ' and the product's reply.

account.description: Present only on a failure raised after an account was chosen: its readable name, as on the interaction object.

account_usage.description: Present only beside account when a quota window was read: percent used, with keys 5h and weekly.

type.description: Present only on failures the gateway raises before a request reaches this service.

FlowImageUpload.description: image must contain inlineData, not mediaId. Images are limited to 20 MiB. The crop, hidden flag and destination options use the native Flow upload.

FlowVideoUpload.description: Video upload up to 1 GiB. Trim bounds are milliseconds and must be supplied together, with end greater than start.

FlowUpload.description: Opaque upload ID; continue with the same ID after a process restart. Query offset after an uncertain append/finalize; never replay accepted bytes. The ID requires a CPA API key and becomes invalid if the broker credential changes.

FlowRequestCancellation.description: Best-effort cancellation of an active broker-owned upstream connection. active=false means no matching active request was found. This does not confirm Google cancellation or roll back created resources.

FlowAgentChat.description: Send prompt or structuredPrompt, not both. Tool calls execute at Google; returned tool events are observations, not instructions to execute again.

FlowToolBuild.description: Run the tool-building agent. Returned TSX/source files execute in the caller's browser, not inside CPA. Supply a unique requestId if cancellation is needed before this buffered call finishes.
